scope: SQLite-backed accounting, authenticated local cloud API integration, and TypeScript project validation

tests.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run packages/cloud-db/test/database.test.ts packages/cloud-db/test/parity.test.ts packages/cloud-usage/test/usage.test.ts packages/cloud-usage/test/stale-reservation.test.ts packages/cloud-entitlements/test/entitlements.test.ts packages/cloud-auth/test/auth.test.ts apps/cloud-api/test/cloud-api.test.ts apps/cloud-api/test/hosted-capacity.test.ts apps/cloud-api/test/hosted-executions.test.ts

coveredScenarios: 500000-credit UTC monthly period creation and no wallet grant
exact remaining balance succeeds and one-credit overspend is rejected
concurrent reservations cannot oversubscribe one account period
settlement consumes actual weighted credits and releases unused reservation
replayed settlement does not double charge
cancellation and stale reservation recovery release unused allowance
historical current-month Free usage is backfilled from usage events
authenticated GET /v1/usage returns authoritative allowance fields and ignores a spoofed account query
limitations: This is control-plane/database test evidence, not physical inference evidence.
PostgreSQL was not available in this environment; its implementation typechecks, but live PostgreSQL parity remains unverified.
